{{Quote|Didn't I tell you to wait aboard the ship?''<br />''I, uh&hellip;I'm sorry, Uupa. I thought something might be wrong.''<br />''Is that why you're carrying an eavesdropping saucer?|Luewet Wuul and Suuas, upon Wuul's discover of Suuas' attempt to spy on him on Crossing Lanes Station|<ref name="Crucible" />}}
An '''eavesdropping saucer''' was a type of [[Listening device/Legends|listening device]]. In [[45 ABY]], the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Suuas]] used an eavesdropping saucer to [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on his relative [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Luewet Wuul]] on the [[Space station/Legends|installation]] [[Crossing Lanes Station]] on behalf of the corporation [[Galactic Syndicated]].
 
==Description==
{{Quote|Cheap Loronar trash. I ''told'' them I wanted SoroSuub.|Suuas, on the eavesdropping saucer given to him by Galactic Syndicated|<ref name="Crucible" />}}
An eavesdropping saucer was a type of listening device resembling a stethoscope with a large suction cup affixed. The device allowed the operator to listen to conversations that were not otherwise audible. <ref name="Crucible" />
 
==History==
{{Quote|&hellip;not even SoroSuub! This is Loronar!How could you, Suuas? ''Loronar''?|Luewet Wuul, on Suuas' use of a Loronar Corporation eavesdropping saucer|<ref name="Crucible" />}}
During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], both the [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar]] and [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] conglomerates manufactured eavesdropping saucers. In [[45 ABY]], the corporation [[Galactic Syndicated]] hired the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Suuas]] to [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on his relative Galactic Alliance [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Luewet Wuul]] and provided Suuas an eavesdropping saucer for the assignment. Though Suuas had specifically requested a SoroSuub-manufactured saucer, he was given a Loronar Corporation-produced device, which he considered to be cheaper and poorer quality than a SoroSuub alternative.<ref name="Crucible" />
 
[[File:Skywalker_Apocalypse.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Luke Skywalker, a Jedi Grand Master who Suuas spied on using an eavesdropping saucer]]
During a meeting aboard the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], ''[[Jade Shadow]]'', docked in a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] at the<ref name="Crucible" /> [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> installation Crossing Lanes Station, Wuul discussed his concerns over recent Galactic Syndicated corporate takeovers. In an attempt to listen in, Suuas affixed his eavesdropping saucer to the ship's [[Hull/Legends|hull]], but was caught and interrogated by Skywalker and Wuul. Wuul further chastised Suuas for using a Loronar-made device instead of one from SoroSuub.<ref name="Crucible" />

==Behind the scenes==
The eavesdropping saucer appeared in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Crucible" />
